criteria.rationale: Additive: a governance-write pose_review_attest and a read-only pose_review_prepare. The CLI, the recorded attestation format, the envelope and claim formats are unchanged; recording and the CLI envelope import now share completeReviewAttestation and RecordReviewAttestationEnvelope, and the existing review and attribution suites pass unchanged.

POSE.md, the pt-BR manual, both scaffold copies and docs-site mcp.md name both tools, the proof requirement and the read-only preparation; the catalog golden and the docs conformance test hold them to the advertised set.

The preview returns the exact bytes an issuer signs and the blockers verify would report, so a channel sees a refusal before signing; refusals name the binding that failed. Full native run at the sealed head with the candidate CLI built from it: 122 of 123 steps pass. The one failure, install-and-upgrade-journeys-integration (the update did not open a configuration review), fails identically on origin/main 25ed81e without this change, run with POSE_JOURNEYS=1 in a separate worktree.

Two MCP tools, one shared completion function extracted from recording, an exported envelope record path, tests, a matrix check, manuals and a fragment. Verification semantics are untouched. Reviewed in the same session that implemented it, with no separate reviewer execution: declared, not independent.

The server holds no key; an apply without a trusted issuer's envelope is refused under any assurance, an untrusted key or content changed after signing is refused with nothing recorded, and an agent confirmation stays declared.
